wiki-china.recent: Xi said Taiwan's reunification must happen because the tide of history cannot be stopped, and left out any mention of force; Taipei rebuffed him. In the same days a Chinese university was shown to have bought Nvidia H200 chips despite the US ban, while Nvidia privately told a lawmaker it can track its chips. Neither story explains the late-October peak.

poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Houthis and Saudi Arabia agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay on the war between Yemen's Houthi movement and the kingdom ending, and so on Red Sea and Gulf oil risk.
poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.recent: Houthis claimed 6 strikes inside the kingdom, debris from intercepted missiles blew out windows across Aramco Tower in Riyadh, and an unclaimed attack set the East-West pipeline ablaze. Saudi-led strikes killed 27 villagers around Sanaa, and Syrian military trainers began working inside Saudi Arabia.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps is Iran's parallel military, founded after the 1979 revolution and answerable to the Supreme Leader. It runs the missile force, a navy in the Gulf and a large business empire.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: French prosecutors said the Guards hacked 700 French supermarkets and heated their freezers, and Paris summoned Iran's envoy. Iran then listed Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations, and New York prosecutors charged three alleged Iran-backed operatives over Fairford. Tankers kept burning on the Guards' Hormuz route.

wiki-united-states.standing: Daily reads of English Wikipedia's article on the United States, one of its most-visited country pages. It rises when American power or politics becomes the world's story, not only America's.
wiki-united-states.recent: The fortnight's news out of the country ran from the Republican midterm loss, which Vance blamed on the Iran war, to Jensen Huang quitting Nvidia and Trump tying tariffs on Mexico to a migrant caravan of 1,500 people. None of it falls on the late-October peak.

poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if senior US and Iranian officials meet in person before its deadline. Its price is what traders will stake on direct talks between two governments that have rarely sat at one table.
poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.recent: Tehran escalated rather than talked: the Revolutionary Guards said 3 tankers hit Hormuz mines and kept the strait shut, the Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, and the Guards claimed to have destroyed a US radar in Bahrain. Trump held off new strikes after Gulf neighbours asked him to, while Netanyahu pressed him almost daily to resume.

stocks:0100.HK.standing: A Shanghai-based artificial intelligence lab that builds large language, video and voice models, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares are a direct price on one of China's challengers to the American AI labs.
stocks:0100.HK.recent: The one story about MiniMax in this window was its listing of 16 openings in San Francisco, part of a push by Chinese AI labs to hire Americans; nothing in it accounts for the fall in its shares.

stocks:KOG.OL.standing: Norway's largest defence contractor, half-owned by the Norwegian state, maker of the NASAMS air-defence system and naval strike missiles. Its share moves on European defence budgets and on orders from NATO governments.

stocks:2359.HK.standing: A Chinese contract research and manufacturing company, listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong, that makes drug ingredients and runs lab work for Western pharmaceutical firms. Its share price tracks how far Washington lets that dependence run.
stocks:2359.HK.recent: The Pentagon dropped WuXi AppTec from its 'Chinese military companies' list to comply with a court ruling. That entry would have opened the way to naming it a biotech 'company of concern' under the BIOSECURE push, the step that decides whether US drugmakers can keep it as a supplier.

stocks:SBK.JO.standing: Africa's largest lender by assets, based in Johannesburg and operating across some 20 African countries. China's ICBC owns about a fifth of it, making it a main conduit for Chinese trade and lending on the continent.

stocks:S68.SI.standing: The company that runs Singapore's stock and derivatives exchanges and their clearing houses. Much of its income comes from futures on Asian assets, from Chinese equities to iron ore, so trading volume drives its earnings.

stocks:BP.standing: American shares of BP, the London-based oil and gas major that produces crude and gas, refines it and sells fuel worldwide. Its earnings rise and fall with oil prices and refining margins.
stocks:BP.recent: BP reported a surge in profit on a refining windfall, a lift for O'Neill's turnaround, and analysts expect eight oil majors to make over $350bn in operating cash between them. Neither the results nor the cash explains the slide in the shares that followed.

stocks:XOM.standing: America's largest oil company, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Guyana's offshore fields and refining fuel and chemicals worldwide. Its shares track oil and gas prices more closely than the wider market.

poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Bola Tinubu wins Nigeria's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay on a second term for the president of Africa's most populous country.
poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.recent: The one Nigerian campaign story in the fortnight came from Gombe, where armed men blocked Isa Pantami's convoy with burning tyres and the attack drew condemnation. Nothing reported in the window accounts for the shift in what traders will pay.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: What traders will pay for a contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. It prices his chances in a crowded field on the right.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital has mostly elected Kuomintang mayors, so this is what traders will pay on the DPP taking it.

stocks:7202.T.standing: The Japanese maker of commercial trucks, pickups and diesel engines, listed in Tokyo. Thailand is its pickup base, so its shares move with the yen and with freight and farm demand across Southeast Asia.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft briefly overtook Nvidia in market value only because Nvidia's own shares fell 6.27%. Two days later Outlook, Teams and Microsoft 365 went down for hours across continents: some servers became 'unexpectedly unavailable' and overloaded the rest, and Downdetector logged 130,000 reports at the peak.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest oil and gas company, producing crude and LNG from Africa to the Middle East and the North Sea, and building a power business. This line is its New York listing, priced in dollars.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Vance blamed the Iran war for the midterm defeat, and Trump has since become the brake: Netanyahu presses him almost daily to resume striking Iran, and one call turned into a shouting match, per Ynet. In Israel, more lawmakers recommended Eisenkot than Netanyahu, who was warned against military moves as caretaker.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud's leader and Israel's longest-serving prime minister. He has shaped Israeli politics, and its wars and its courts, for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: The vote count left Netanyahu without a majority: 67 of 120 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot to Herzog against 46 for him, and 19 Arab-party seats decide who governs. As caretaker he still commands Israel's security services, and he presses Trump almost daily to resume striking Iran, after Trump said $4 billion in Israel aid stops at year-end.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member, leaving Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, as interim CEO under Harvey Jones, the board's first-ever chairman. US officials believe Chinese intelligence targeted him through Megaspeed's Alice Huang, whose employer reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-on-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes Claude, lists its shares publicly on November 19, 2026. A listing would put a public market price on one of the leading AI developers for the first time.

stocks:SCC.BK.standing: Thailand's largest industrial group, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and part-owned by the Crown Property Bureau. It makes cement, building materials, petrochemicals and packaging across Southeast Asia.
stocks:SCC.BK.recent: The one development on the company's own business came after the latest close: SCG said its core plastics plant in Vietnam, knocked out by the Hormuz disruption, stays shut until mid-2027. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before that.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: Brent closed October up about 15% as the US threatened Iran over Hormuz. Then the market tipped: JP Morgan estimated a 1.4 million barrel-a-day surplus, Saudi Arabia reported output up 26%, and Brent fell below $90 even as Houthi missiles hit Riyadh and an attack struck the East-West pipeline.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: No story in the input was about Hegseth. The nearest was a CoinDesk guide to the key races to watch for the 2026 election, and nothing in it accounts for the price.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by Dec 31. It is a bet on whether a new funding round or share sale sets that mark before the year ends.

stocks:IBM.standing: International Business Machines, the century-old American computing company, now earns most of its money from hybrid-cloud software, Red Hat and mainframes sold to banks and governments, with a consulting arm alongside.
stocks:IBM.recent: The one development in its own business is a plan to link two 520-qubit chips into a 1,040-qubit system that users can reach in 2027, a step on its roadmap to error-corrected quantum computers before 2030. That was announced after the latest close, so it does not explain the share's climb.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Iran said Oman had agreed Hormuz shipping lanes, a claim carried by Russia's TASS, but the same day the Revolutionary Guards said 3 tankers hit mines and kept the strait shut. A day later two supertankers carrying over 4 million barrels exploded on a route Iran had not authorised, and Trump said Washington no longer needs a deal with Iran.

stocks:TMUS.standing: One of the three national mobile carriers in the United States, majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom since it absorbed Sprint in 2020. Its subscriber fight with Verizon and AT&T carries much of the German parent's value.
stocks:TMUS.recent: New York accused T-Mobile of throttling the internet service it sells to low-income households to 600 Kbps. A state charge against its own business is a cost, not a lift, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share climbing to its high the same day.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: The news about United in this window was not about its finances: it barred AI agents such as OpenAI's from booking its flights, the first major carrier to do so, and its chief executive doubted Boom's supersonic airliner would be ready by 2029. Neither accounts for the share price, and the ban came after the rise.

stocks:LUV.standing: The share price of Southwest Airlines, the largest US domestic carrier by passengers, built on a single Boeing 737 fleet and point-to-point routes. It moves with jet fuel costs and with how full planes on US routes are.

poly-variational-fdv-above-800m-one-day-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Variational, a crypto derivatives trading venue, opens above $800M in fully diluted value: its token price times total supply on the first day of trading.

poly-will-nvidia-be-the-largest-company-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether NVIDIA will be the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation on 31 December. It is a bet on the AI chip trade holding its lead over the other trillion-dollar tech giants.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency with no central issuer, launched in 2009. Surges mark the moments the coin reaches people outside the trading world.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Nothing here explains the earlier peak. Since then a hack linked to North Korea took at least $5.9 billion from Binance, users withdrew a net $4.72 billion once withdrawals reopened, MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, and bitcoin fell below $70,000.

stocks:BIDU.standing: China's largest search engine, whose New York-listed shares also price its bets on Ernie AI models, Kunlun chips and Apollo Go robotaxis.
stocks:BIDU.recent: Baidu's own news in the window was product work: an AI agent in Wuhan that turns residents' group chats into work orders, and a world model built in Shenzhen to train robotaxis in simulation. None of it accounts for the share price.

stocks:MSTR.standing: The former MicroStrategy, a business-software firm that became the largest listed holder of bitcoin, buying it by selling its own shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on the coin.
stocks:MSTR.recent: Bitcoin fell below $76K as an AI stock rout hit Strategy, Coinbase and Circle, taking the value of its 850,364 bitcoin down with it. MSCI then ruled that a company whose business is buying bitcoin is a fund and confirmed it will drop it from its indexes. Index funds must sell, and a model that sells shares and debt to buy more bitcoin loses its passive buyers.

stocks:MSCI.standing: The New York-listed firm behind the MSCI World and Emerging Markets indexes, which it licenses to fund managers with risk analytics and ESG ratings. Its fees scale with the money tracking those indexes.
stocks:MSCI.recent: The one MSCI story came after the chart's last day. MSCI ruled that Strategy, whose business is buying bitcoin, is a fund rather than an operating company, and dropped it from its indexes. Nothing reported explains the earlier rise.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, Donald Trump's vice president, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks the fortunes of the heir to Trump's movement.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: The slide followed a blowout midterm defeat for Trump's side, capped by a shock result built on the Black vote in Mississippi. Vance then clashed with Trump over the election catastrophe and blamed the Iran war for it, while Trump made Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle, a public split at the top of the party Vance hopes to inherit.

stocks:C.standing: The New York-based bank with the widest overseas reach of America's largest lenders. Its treasury and trade arm moves cash for multinationals across dozens of countries, so its shares respond to global trade and interest rates.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The trough came as Bloomberg reported SpaceX's default risk at a fresh peak during a tech-led selloff. Since then it has unveiled $74 billion of AI computing campuses in Texas and Arizona, and Bloomberg reports a merger with Tesla could be announced in December. The European Commission is demanding Starshield be restored in Ukraine.

stocks:9984.T.standing: SoftBank Group is the Tokyo-listed holding company Masayoshi Son built. Its value rests mainly on stakes in other companies, chiefly the chip designer Arm and its bets on AI, so its share price moves with the price of AI.
stocks:9984.T.recent: Over the fortnight SoftBank signed Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan. Then, after the low, it booked more than $3 billion in losses on turbine deposits meant for AI power from natural gas. Neither event explains the fall in the share.

stocks:WHL.JO.standing: A Johannesburg-listed retailer that runs the Woolworths stores in South Africa, selling premium food, clothing and homeware, plus Country Road Group in Australia. Its food arm is a gauge of what the middle class still spends.
stocks:WHL.JO.recent: Woolworths reported that turnover at Woolworths Foods grew only 1.9% and concession sales just 0.1%. That is a sharp slowdown in the food business the group relies on to sell to South Africa's middle class, and the shares fell on the figures.

poly-will-pablo-hernandez-de-cos-be-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Pablo Hernández de Cos, the former Bank of Spain governor, succeeds Christine Lagarde at the European Central Bank, which sets interest rates for the twenty countries that use the euro.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: Huang quit Nvidia after its board probed his affair with Alice Huang, whose employer reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment, as US officials said Chinese intelligence had targeted him. Sen. Cramer had called on him to resign, and Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, now runs Nvidia as interim CEO.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir sells software that pulls scattered records into one searchable picture, to armies, spy agencies, police forces and large companies. Government contracts are its core, so its fortunes follow public budgets and politics.
stocks:PLTR.recent: Palantir held its Q3 2026 earnings call, and Michael Burry stayed short going into the Nov. 2 report, though nothing here says what the results contained. In Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, a left coalition rejected Palantir's software while still planning automated police data analysis. Neither accounts for the slide in the share.

stocks:MBG.DE.standing: The Stuttgart carmaker behind Mercedes-Benz cars and vans, listed in Frankfurt. Its profits lean on wealthy buyers in China and on exports to the US, so Chinese demand and tariffs reach the share quickly.
stocks:MBG.DE.recent: Four months of talks in Germany ended with Mercedes-Benz halting investment in its home country, the one development here about the company's own business. It came on the last day of the window, so it does not explain the rise before it.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-400m-one-day-a.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Predict.fun's token, once it starts trading, is valued above $400M fully diluted (price times total supply) the day after launch. It shows what traders will pay on a new token's first-day valuation.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-betwe.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued between $1.75 trillion and $2 trillion on its first day as a listed company. It is one band of a ladder, so bettors' money shows where they place the listing.

poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if crude oil sets a new all-time price record before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and a record would pass straight into fuel, freight and inflation.
poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.recent: The fortnight carried a rising chance of a December Fed hike, which traders put at 78%, but no supply outage, sanction or war in the oil market that would explain why bets on a record faded.

stocks:ISP.MI.standing: Italy's largest bank by assets, listed in Milan. It holds a large stock of Italian government bonds, so its shares move with the spread Rome pays over Germany and with any change in how the state taxes its lenders.
stocks:ISP.MI.recent: Intesa publicly attacked the bank levies in Italy's 2027 budget, which seeks €5.9 billion from the country's banks next year, and said the ECB may intervene. That dispute surfaced after the latest reading, so it does not explain the share's path over the window.

wiki-european-central-bank.standing: The central bank of the countries that use the euro, based in Frankfurt. It sets one interest rate for the whole currency area and supervises its largest banks, so its decisions reach mortgages and state borrowing across Europe.
wiki-european-central-bank.recent: Lagarde's early departure on 7 February opened a race to succeed her that narrowed to two candidates, Knot and De Cos, with the Eurogroup aiming to pick by year end. Meanwhile Panetta and Nagel argued for a December rate hike, the third this year, with eurozone inflation at 4%.

stocks:TSLA.standing: The Austin-based maker of electric cars and of batteries that store grid power, run by Elon Musk. Its share price carries bets on driverless taxis and robots worth far more than its car sales earn.
stocks:TSLA.recent: The rebound began when Musk killed the Cybertruck, which Cox Automotive estimates sold 11,586 in nine months, to turn Tesla towards robotics and AI. Tesla then said its Cybercab meets federal safety standards, and Bloomberg reported SpaceX and Tesla were weighing a December merger announcement.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Reserve Bank of India leaves its repo rate, the rate at which it lends to commercial banks, unchanged at its December meeting. That rate sets the cost of borrowing across India.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.recent: The fortnight's news was about the Fed, not the RBI: Logan and Daly called for more rate hikes after core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October, and two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points. None of it bears directly on what traders will pay for the RBI holding in December.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the San Francisco maker of the Claude AI models, lists its shares publicly by November 19, 2026. A listing would let ordinary investors buy into a frontier AI lab directly.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire by 15 November. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on strikes, talks and statements from either capital.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: Trump posted that there is no need for a deal with Iran on the same day Iran's Guards claimed to have destroyed a US radar in Bahrain. A day earlier, Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, while Netanyahu was pressing Trump almost daily to resume striking Iran.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran sign a final agreement on Iran's nuclear programme before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.recent: Trump said there was no need for a deal with Iran, a day after Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty. Around them, the Revolutionary Guards said 3 tankers hit Hormuz mines and claimed a US radar in Bahrain, while Netanyahu pushed Trump almost daily to resume striking Iran.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight's news about Alibaba's own business mostly ran the other way. Apple chose Qwen to run its iPhone AI and Siri in China, and Alibaba sold nearly 100,000 AI monthly passes at one fen each. Neither accounts for the fall in its shares.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, closes its first day of public trading worth less than $1.25 trillion. It is a wager on how the market will price one of the largest AI developers.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its January 2027 meeting. Its price is what bettors will pay, in cents on the dollar, for that outcome.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: Core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October, and Fed officials answered in turn: Logan called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly, Daly said more were likely needed, and Williams called inflation 'far too high'. Two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points as money moved onto hikes running past December into the new year.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The field of building machines that do tasks once thought to need human intelligence, from language and vision to planning. Its large models now drive chip demand, data-centre spending and much of stock market value.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: An AI share rout spread to Asia, where South Korea halted trading after the Kospi fell 8%, and copper slid on AI fears; it came a week after Amazon's AI spending drove a record $42.4 billion cash burn. Since then Nvidia's Jensen Huang has faced a shareholder lawsuit, and Trump has backed Lutnick through an uproar over Nvidia chip controls.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: The IAEA formally urged Tehran to restore inspector access, and Iran replied that inspections are impossible in the current security situation. That week Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, and Washington offered up to $20 million to informants on Iran's nuclear program while Trump weighed renewed strikes.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for a contract that pays out if Josh Shapiro, Pennsylvania's governor, becomes the Democrats' 2028 presidential nominee. It prices a swing-state governor's place in an open, crowded field.

poly-will-john-mcentee-win-the-2028-repu.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if John McEntee, Donald Trump's former White House personnel chief and longtime aide, wins the Republican presidential nomination in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kling, Kuaishou's AI video unit, closed a record round of about 19.8 billion yuan, a private price that valued it above the listed company that owns it. The raise came as Chinese giants moved their AI units toward listings of their own in Hong Kong, with Alibaba keeping control of T-Head after it lists there.

poly-will-zoran-jankovic-win-the-2026-lj.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Zoran Janković wins Ljubljana's 2026 mayoral election. He has run Slovenia's capital since 2006 and has won every mayoral race since, despite repeated corruption investigations.

poly-will-nicols-maduro-be-the-leader-of.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Nicolás Maduro is still leading Venezuela when 2026 ends. Its price is what traders will stake on his keeping power, and it moves on Caracas politics and on Washington's stance toward him.
